Green PDF Reader — Onion folder drop-in
=======================================

Built from master 33b450a (auto-zoom, wider bookmarks, 180° remapped
present, zoom/pan keep, H-scroll, scoped launch libs, Pango Arabic TOC).

Install (copy onto SD card)
---------------------------
1) App/Green/  →  /mnt/SDCARD/App/Green/
   (launch.sh + config.json)

2) bin/green/  →  /mnt/SDCARD/.tmp_update/bin/green/
   (green binary, fonts.conf, fonts/, lib/*.so.0)

Important: lib/*.so.0 are real ELF files (not symlinks) for FAT SD cards.

3) Put PDFs in /mnt/SDCARD/Media/PDF/
4) Onion Apps → PDF Reader

launch.sh scopes FONTCONFIG/LD_LIBRARY_PATH only around the green binary
so the stock file picker is unaffected. Check Saves/.../green/green-launch.log
if startup fails.
